test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Since these people used tobacco to ______ their deities, the herb itself was one of the instruments of godless, false religions.
solution:
Here, the correct answer is** "propitiate."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****
 

__
 
• The reason to use **"propitiate"** in the blank is to convey the idea that the people used tobacco as an offering or a means to appease or win favor from their deities.
 
• **"Propitiate"** means to win or regain the favor of a god, spirit, or person by doing something that pleases them. (किसी देवता, आत्मा या व्यक्ति को प्रसन्न करने वाला कोई कार्य करके उसका अनुग्रह जीतना या पुनः प्राप्त करना)
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 

Correct sentence*: Since these people used tobacco to **propitiate**__ their deities, the herb itself was one of the instruments of godless, false religions. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Trace: **to find out where somebody/something is by following marks, signs or other information. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु का पता लगाना (चिह्नों, संकेतों या अन्‍य जानकारी की सहायता से))
 
• **Militate: **(of a fact or circumstance) be a powerful or conclusive factor in preventing. ((किसी तथ्य या परिस्थिति को) रोकने में एक शक्तिशाली या निर्णायक कारक होना)
 
• **Expatiate: **to speak or write about something in great detail or for a long time. (किसी चीज़ के बारे में बहुत विस्तार से या लंबे समय तक बोलना या लिखना)
